title: perf(console): request every chunk a page load needs in one wave

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化:用户打开控制台列表页或记录页时,页面所需代码改为一次并行请求,不再一层层排队;在 150 毫秒网络延迟下,首条数据约提前 0.8 到 1 秒出现。
- 为什么:属于控制台首屏加载提速专项的第二步,替离服务器较远的托管控制台用户省掉代码下载的逐层往返。
- 如果判断错:最坏是浏览器提前下载了本来稍后才会下载的同一批代码,或新加的构建检查拦下控制台构建;数据和功能不受影响,整体撤回即可恢复原样。
- 需要您做的:无。

## What changes

Slice 2 of the console load-waterfall card, option A as approved (claim amendment 7035865954). Nothing moves between chunks; only WHEN a chunk is requested changes.

- `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`: `build.modulePreload` goes from `false` to `{ polyfill: false, resolveDependencies }`, and the stale comment beside it is replaced.
  - The HTML host keeps Vite's deps, which are the entry's static (eager) closure: `index.html` now names all 105 eager files instead of 6.
  - An `import()` preloads the imported chunk's static closure beside it, minus the eager files (already loaded by then) and the target itself.
  - `preloadCriticalChunks()` and `CRITICAL_CHUNK_PREFIXES` are retired: the hand list is a subset of what the HTML host now preloads.
- `ui/scripts/vite-eager-preload.ts` (new): the policy plus the hop pin, a build-time guard (`assert-eager-preload`) that reads the EMITTED `index.html` and chunks and fails the console build when:
  - an eager file is found only after the file that imports it (wave above 1), or
  - an `import()` site leaves part of its target's static closure to be discovered after the target arrives.
  - It refuses to judge (an error, never a pass) when its own reader disagrees with Rollup's `chunk.imports`, when the eager closure has fewer than 2 files, when no site has a closure to preload, or when the `ObjectView` / `RecordDetailView` route sites are missing.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/vite-eager-preload.test.ts` (new): 16 tests over minified Vite-shaped fixtures, including the CONTROL (today's `modulePreload: false` shape is red) and source pins on the config wiring.
- `.changeset/35455-console-preload-chunks.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch.

Option B (moving `slugify` out of `runtime-metadata-persistence`) was NOT needed: in the after-reading, the `createDerive` / `romanizeHan` / `runtime-metadata-persistence` / `objectViewViewCrud` chunks all arrive in the same wave as `ObjectView`. Option C is out of this slice.

Byte cost: 0 modules moved (105 of 2549 chunks eager on both sides, same membership). The eager closure grows by +19,416 B raw / +8,742 B gzip, which is the new `__vite__mapDeps` file lists and the preload helper only. `index.html` goes from 33,792 to 42,493 B. `check:eager-closure` stays green: 1944.8 KB gzipped against a 2431.6 KB budget.

Migrated or retired tests: none. Platform-checklist items edited: none (none matched).

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/scripts/vite-eager-preload.ts`, `dynamicSitesOf`: the regex reader of minified preload sites. It is cross-checked against Rollup's `chunk.imports` and refuses on mismatch, but it is the part a Vite upgrade can move.
2. `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`, the `modulePreload` block: the policy that decides what each site preloads.
3. `ui/scripts/__tests__/vite-eager-preload.test.ts`, the CONTROL case.

Two-minute verification: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/vite-eager-preload.test.ts` → `Tests 19 passed (19)`. Or build the console and look for the `assert-eager-preload` line "every file a load needs is requested in one wave: 105 eager files all named by index.html, …".

## Tests

- New suite: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/vite-eager-preload.test.ts` → Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 19 passed (19), at 233d03caa30. The guard reads index.html under the build's resolved base (the E2E build uses `/console/`); an HTML that names no entry chunk under that base is refused, never guessed.
- The derived `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` family ran under the lock: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts` (`tsconfig.scripts.json`, `scripts/**/*.ts`; `--listFiles` shows both new files) → exit 0.
- `tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force` in the console (covers `vite.config.ts` and `../../scripts/vite-*.ts`) → exit 0.
- The guard over real builds: the CONTROL on today's build is red, and the same guard on this branch's build is green.

## Acceptance notes

- Before/after on the same box with the same method on both sides: `objectstack dev --fresh` from the showcase app on a private port, headless Chromium 1440x900, a new context per load, Resource Timing from navigation to networkidle + 3 s. n=3, list and record, cold and warm, h1 and h2 + 150 ms. "first module call" and "first data" are ms from navigation. Medians:

- The card's done-when (about 3 API layers) is NOT met: API-only layers are 7–14 after, roughly unchanged. What this slice removes is the JS part of the chain. That is why the card line is `Refs`, not a closing line. `me/localization` is 1 on every load.
- The wall-clock figures come from a shared box (other agents' work ran beside them). Both sides were measured in the same session with the same method, so read the ratios, not the absolutes.
- Deviation: root `pnpm dev` is refused by `check-dev-prereqs`, so the server ran as `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev --fresh -p PORT`, the same as slice 1.
- Deviation: the first after-build preloaded every dep Vite listed at every `import()` site, eager files included. That added +42.6 KB gzip to the eager closure, all of it repeated names of eager files in the `__vite__mapDeps` lists. The policy now drops eager files, which are already loaded when any `import()` runs, and the final cost is the +8.7 KB gzip above.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 inside the locked gate run; its output was overwritten by the next gate. A standalone rerun right after exited 0 (124 entry points across 72 packages load). It reads no file this diff touches.

## Verification

- Local gates at 546efd9e5c9: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 44 families. All 44 ran under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0, held 1402 s), and every one exited 0 apart from the `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` note above.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: "44 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 44 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure` → exit 0: "1944.8 KB gzipped across 105 of 2549 chunks (budget: 2431.6 KB, headroom: 486.8 KB)", every per-chunk ceiling green.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` → exit 0, "0 new citation(s)".
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before the push → exit 0, "VERDICT clean exit 0".
- Not run locally, left to CI: the lint workflow's whole farm, the console's full `tsc --noEmit`, and e2e.
